text:
You need help fixing an Amazon compliance flat file error in Excel so you can upload the required documents as soon as possible.

Hi, I can help you troubleshoot the flat file and clean up the Excel so it matches what Amazon is expecting. With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m comfortable working through messy spreadsheets, identifying formatting issues, and turning them into upload-ready files.

For this kind of urgent Amazon compliance issue, I would first review the file structure, column formatting, required fields, and any values that may be causing the upload error. Then I’d compare the flat file against the documents Amazon is requesting, check for missing or inconsistent data, and correct any Excel issues that could be blocking the submission. If needed, I can also help organize the supporting information so the file is easier to review and upload.

I know these situations can be time-sensitive, especially when Amazon is waiting on compliance documentation. My focus would be on getting you a clean, accurate spreadsheet quickly, while keeping the process straightforward and clear. I’m comfortable with data cleanup, spreadsheet troubleshooting, and making sure the file is structured properly for submission.

If you share the current flat file and the exact error message, I can start by pinpointing what is causing the upload failure and what needs to be fixed in Excel. From there, I can help you correct the file so it is ready to submit with minimal back-and-forth.

What is the exact error message Amazon is showing when you try to upload the flat file?
